shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum closed Q3 strong but face Q4 macro headwinds and an upcoming Ethereum upgrade.
Crypto market sentiment is shifting from "Greed" to "Neutral"; Ethereum ETFs saw outflows and Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed.
US Fed officials are cooling immediate rate hike expectations, but high Treasury yields continue to persist.
Key crypto regulations are now taking effect in the UK and South Korea.
Major institutions, including BlackRock, are increasing blockchain use and crypto exposure.
